title: EMemBench: Interactive Benchmarking of Episodic Memory for VLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2601.16690v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce EMemBench, a programmatic benchmark generator for evaluating long-term episodic memory of agents through interactive games. Rather than using a fixed set of questions, EMemBench generates questions from environment-grounded trajectories, covering both text-only and visual game environments. Each template computes verifiable ground truth from underlying game signals, with controlled answerability and balanced coverage over memory skills: single/multi-hop recall, induction, temporal, spatial, logical, and adversarial. We evaluate memory agents with strong LMs/VLMs as backbones, using in-context prompting as baselines. Across 15 text games and multiple visual seeds, results are far from saturated: induction and spatial reasoning are persistent bottlenecks, especially in visual settings. translated_title: EMemBench：面向VLM智能体的情景记忆交互式基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EMemBench，这是一个程序化基准生成器，用于通过交互式游戏评估智能体的长期情景记忆。EMemBench不使用固定的问题集，而是从基于环境的轨迹中生成问题，同时涵盖纯文本和视觉游戏环境。每个模板都从底层游戏信号计算出可验证的真实答案（ground truth），具有可控的可回答性，并对记忆技能实现均衡覆盖：单跳/多跳回忆、归纳、时间、空间、逻辑和对抗性技能。我们以强大的LM/VLM作为骨干网络评估记忆智能体，并使用上下文提示作为基线。在15个文本游戏和多个视觉种子上的实验结果表明，性能远未饱和：归纳和空间推理是持续存在的瓶颈，尤其是在视觉环境中。持久记忆为开源骨干模型在文本游戏上带来了明显收益，但对VLM智能体的改进则不太一致，这表明……
tldr: EMemBench是一个程序化基准生成器，通过交互式游戏从环境轨迹中自动生成可验证真实答案的问题，全面评估智能体的长期情景记忆，实验发现归纳和空间推理仍是当前LM/VLM智能体的主要瓶颈，尤其在视觉环境中。
en_tdlr: EMemBench is a programmatic benchmark generator that evaluates the long-term episodic memory of LM/VLM agents through interactive games with verifiable ground-truth questions, revealing that induction and spatial reasoning remain persistent bottlenecks, especially in visual settings.
